scene: You step into bustling Tailors' Arcade.
picture: In a vibrant pixel-art arcade, the empty glass-roofed trolley rests on tracks at the left. Center stands the woman in her lilac headscarf and mustard coat. Piles of blue cloth sit far left, an old weaver works a wooden loom on the right, and an ornate archway with a bell marks the far right.
shown: a stack of bright blue cloth bolts sitting untended on the far left
an elderly weaver working at a wooden pedal loom on the right
a hanging brass bell fixed to a patterned archway on the far right
